Compute Keccak-256 of Raw Bytes or a UTF-8 String

Source: R/keccak.R
keccak256.Rd

Ethereum uses the original Keccak (the pre-FIPS-202 padding scheme), NOT SHA3-256. We hash with secretbase::keccak(), which bundles its own Keccak implementation and so is portable across systems regardless of the system OpenSSL version. (openssl::keccak() depends on the system OpenSSL exposing the legacy keccak-256 algorithm, which only exists in OpenSSL >= 3.2 and is absent on many systems.)

Usage

keccak256(x)

Arguments

x

(raw | scalar<character>) raw bytes, or a length-1 character string (encoded as UTF-8 before hashing).

Value

(vector<raw, 32>) a plain raw(32) digest.

Examples

keccak256("") # the empty-string Ethereum vector
#>  [1] c5 d2 46 01 86 f7 23 3c 92 7e 7d b2 dc c7 03 c0 e5 00 b6 53 ca 82 27 3b 7b
#> [26] fa d8 04 5d 85 a4 70
keccak256(as.raw(c(0x12, 0x34)))
#>  [1] 56 57 0d e2 87 d7 3c d1 cb 60 92 bb 8f de e6 17 39 74 95 5f de f3 45 ae 57
#> [26] 9e e9 f4 75 ea 74 32
